report:
Conclusion — there is an interpretable difference:

- Direction: The B − A residual difference (especially at early token positions, pos0–pos1, concentrated in late layers ~24–25 and also layers 16–22 pos1) pushes the model toward web/blog/news/advertising-style tokens and named-entity / elite-political tokens. In other words, Model B (relative to A) is biased toward starting continuations that look like blog/news/advert/press-content: tokens such as blog/blogger/blogging/blogs, photo/facebook/sexy, ad/ads/Mail/TV, seminar/seminars, metropolitan/touch/Touchscreen, and named people/elite words (Obama, billionaire, chairman, spokeswoman, journalists, politicians).

- Evidence:
  - The L2-norms are largest at the first one or two token positions in late layers (24–25, and a big mass around 16–22 pos1), which is where output-shaping late-layer residuals typically affect the first continuation tokens.
  - The logit-lens top tokens for the highest-norm cells repeatedly show tokens from the same semantic clusters: blog/blogger/blogging/blogs, ad/ads/Mail/TV, photo/facebook/sexy, and political/elite terms (Obama, billionaire, politicians, spokesman, journalists, chairman, metropolitan). Those are the tokens the difference vectors point toward in vocabulary space, so B−A moves logits in that direction.
  - (Patchscope readouts were not provided / empty, so no continuation samples to contradict or refine this.)

- Caveats: The evidence supports a broad domain/genre shift (toward blog/news/advert-like openings and named-entity / elite/political vocabulary) but does not by itself prove a single narrowly defined objective (for example it does not establish changes in toxicity, sentiment, or a specific classifier head). Also some low-level tokens (newline, punctuation, parentheses) appear among high-norm cells, suggesting small-formatting differences as well.

If you want, I can (a) show how strong this effect is on model output by injecting the difference into prompts (patchscope sampling), or (b) try to cluster the high-scoring tokens to give a cleaner list of the dominant semantic themes.
